text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the Hopeful Stakes has 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, all the spectators could talk 
about were the two who had shown 
spectacular performances ever since their 
debut—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was talking about whether Winning 
Ticket or Biwa Hayahide would claim the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To prove her strength to the world and 
make her presence known, Narita Taishin 
stepped up to the race.
